chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jesu in hih bangin gen hi: “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah tuu khumna tuukulh kongpi pan a lut lo, mun dang khat kanin a lut peuhmah guta buluh ahi hi.
Kongpi pan a lut mipa ahihleh tuute a cing tuucingpa ahi hi.
Kongcingpa in amah kong hon a, tuute in zong ama' aw ngai uh hi. Amah in a tuute a min uh tawh samin pusuahpih hi.
A tuute a vekin a pusuahpih khit ciangin tuute' mai-ah pai a, tuute in zong ama' aw thei uh ahih manin amah zui uh hi.
Tuute in tualpua midang khat zui lo ding uh a, a kiangpan taikhiazaw ding uh hi. A hang pen amaute in tualpua midangte' aw thei lo uh hi.”
Jesu in tua mite' tungah hih etsakna thutom gen a, ahih hangin amaute in Jesu' gen thu theitel lo uh hi.
Tua hangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: “Maantak diktak kong cihin ah kei pen tuu kongpi ka hi hi.
Kei' ma-a hong paite guta buluh vive hi uh a, himah taleh tuute in amau' aw thudon lo uh hi.
Kei pen kongpi ka hi hi. Mi khatpeuh kei hong tawnin a lut leh galbitna ngah ding a, sungtum pusuakin lonona mun mukha ding hi.
Gutapa pen a gu ding, a go ding leh a susia ding bekin hong pai hi. Kei ka hihleh tuute nuntakna a nei bek hilo, a dimletin a neih nadingun a hong pai ka hi hi.
Kei pen tuucing hoih ka hi hi. Tuucing hoih in a tuute' ading a nuntakna piakhia ngam hi.
Tuucing ahilo, tuu zong a neilo, a kicialpa in ngia hong pai a muh ciangin tuute nusia-in taimang a, ngia in tuute bawhin kithehthangsak hi.
A kicialpa pen a kicialtawm hi a, tuute khual vet lo ahih manin a taimang ahi hi.
Kei pen tuucing hoih ka hi hi. Keima' ate ka thei a, keima' ate in kei hong thei uh hi.
Tua pen Pa in kei hong thei-in ke'n zong Pa ka theih bang lian ahi hi. Tua hi a, tuute' ading nuntakna ka paai ngam hi.
Hih tuukulh pan ahilo tuu dangte zong ka nei lai hi. Tuuhon zong lom khat, tuucing zong khat, ahih nadingin amaute zong kong paipih ding a, amaute in ka aw hong ngai ding uh hi.
Hih thu hangin Pa in kei hong it a, tua pen ka lakkik theih dingin ka nuntakna paai ngam ka hih man ahi hi.

Kei' kiangpan kuamah in hong sutkhia hilo a, keima' ut thu tawh ka piaktawm hizaw hi. Piak theih nading thu ka nei a, lakkik theih nading thu zong ka nei hi. Hih thupiak pen ka Pa' kiangpan ka ngah ahi hi.”
Hih thugennate hangin Jew mite kikal ah lungsim kikakna piang leuleu hi.
Mi tampi in, “Hih mipa dawilawm nei hi a, lungsim cidamlo ahi hi. Bang hangin a thugen ngai na hi uh hiam?” ci uh hi.
A dangte in, “Hih thute dawilut khat ii gen nam hilo hi. Dawi in khuamulote a mit uh honsak thei ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua hunin Jerusalem khua ah Ki-apna Pawi kibawl hi. Phalbi hita a,
Jesu pen biakinnpi huang sung Solomon' Talap dung ah lampai-in om hi.
Tua hangin ama' kiim ah Jew mite hong ki-uum uh a, “Kote' lungsim a laklawhin bangtanvei hong koih ding na hi hiam? Khris na hihleh siangtak hong gen in,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Kong gen khin a, na um kei uh hi. Ka Pa' min tawh gamta-a ka sepkhiat teng in keima' thu genin teci pang uh hi.
Himah taleh ka tuuhon lakah kihel lo na hih manun na um kei uh hi.
Ka tuute in ka aw hong ngai uh a, ke'n zong amaute thei-in amaute in kei hong zui uh hi.
Amaute tawntung nuntakna pia ka hih manin si ngeilo ding uh a, kuamah in ka khutsung pan amaute hong sutkhia lo ding uh hi.
Amaute hong pia ka Pa pen kuamahpeuh sangin lianzaw ahih manin kuamah in ka Pa' khutsung pan amaute sutkhia zolo ding hi.
Kei leh ka Pa pumkhat ka hi uh hi.”
Jesu deng dingin Jew mite in suang tawm leuleu uh hi.
Jesu in, “Pa' kiangpan hong pai nahoih sepna tampi kong lak khinzo hi. Tuate a koi pen hangin suang tawh hong den sawm na hi uh hiam?” ci hi.
Jew makaite in, “Kong den sawm uh pen nahoih na sepna hang hilo-in Pasian na gendaina hang hizaw hi. Mihing hinapi-in nangmahmah Pasian bangin na kibawl hi,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Na thukhun sung uhah, ‘Note pen pasiante na hi uh hi, kong ci hi,’ ci-in kigelh hilo ahi hiam?
Pasian' thu a sang mite pasiante kici ahihleh—Pasian' Laibu zong kiphiat theilo ahihleh—
‘Pasian' Tapa ka hi hi,’ ka cihna hangin Pa' siansuahpa, leitung ah a hong sawl mipa' kiangah ‘Pasian na gendai hi,’ ci thei ding na hi uh hiam?
Ka Pa' nasepte ka sep keileh kei hong um kei pah un.
Ahi zongin ka sep leh kei nong um kei uh zongin ka septe um beek un. Tua hileh Pa' sungah kei omin kei' sungah Pa om ahihlam thei-in na tel ding uh hi.”
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu mat sawm leuleu uh a, ahih hangin amaute' khutsung pan Jesu suakta hi.
Tua ciangin Jordan gun kantanin John' baptize masakna mun ah Jesu paikhia leuleu a, tua takah taam hi.
Mi tampi hong pai uh a, “John in kihilna lim bangmah bawl lo hi. Ahih hangin hih mipa vai ama' gen khempeuh maan hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua hi a, tua takah mi tampi in Jesu um uh hi.
